About me

Good books deserve to be found.

I started Sammie Digital Growth because too many good books go unread. Often the problem is not the writing. It is that the right readers never hear about the book. My work is to close that gap.

I focus on book marketing for independent authors: launch plans, Amazon KDP promotion, category and ranking campaigns, and creative that makes a book stand out, from trailers to social content.

I keep things honest. I cannot promise bestseller status and I will tell you that upfront. What I do promise is clear communication, careful work and steady effort on your book from the first conversation to launch day and beyond.
